tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// tshogs 'khor bsdus pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs gyur pa'i// zag med ye shes zab yangs gangs can mtsho// yon tan mi zad rin chen gter 'dzin pa// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// bde bas sdug bsngal ma lus dpyis 'byin cing*// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal 'byor thob byed pa// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga don gnyer ba'i// skye bo skal ldan rnams la bshad par bya// tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed par 'dod pas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bshams la/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs/ srung ba'i 'khor lo sngon du 'gro ba'i kye rdo rje bsgoms nas/ sngags kyi bzlas pa gang grub pa bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las lha yi mchod rdzas ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bar bskyed nas so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dngos su rten yod pa'am med kyang rung ste/ rang gis bsgoms pa ltar bskyed/ ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ de'i mtha' mar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar bsam/ de la thog mar phyi'i mchod pa bya ste/ ngag tu/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ bha ga wān/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra ni ri te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du zhal bsil/ ni wi te āḥhūm̐/ 'thor 'thung*/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkham̐ ram̐ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa rnams kyis chu rnams dbul/ de nas/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge

/dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis// zhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ bha ga wān/ la sogs pa'i mthar/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog dbul/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang*// gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra dhūp+pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos dbul/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed pa// dge zhing mun pa rnams sel ba// bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me dbul/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab dbul/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas dbul/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pradzñ+yā pā ra mi tā/ nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra dharma hṝ da yan/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā zhes pas rol mo dbul/ de nas nang mchod kyang gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams la dbul/ de nas yi dam gyi lha rnams la so so'i sngags kyis dbul lo// de nas rang gi lce dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga rnams su thig le bkod nas/ lus kyi lha rnams mchod/ de nas chos skyong la oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā li de wī oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas lha mo dang*/

yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa bzhes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ lha chen po brgyad dang*/ klu chen po brgyad dang*/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ gza' chen po brgyad dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba rnams mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad tshim par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pas mchod cing nang mchod dbul lo// de nas rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mos mchod par bsam zhing*/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// zhes pa la sogs pas mchod nas/ bstod pa ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje bsgrubs pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes// zhes pa la sogs pas bstod nas/ de nas gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ thog mar mngon par rtogs pa las 'byung ba bzhin du 'jig rten las 'das pa la dbul/ gnyis pa chos skyong la/ gsum pa a kā ro'i sngags kyis 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dang gzhi bdag la sbyin no// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams mdun du bsags nas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phud bla ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ gtor ma la dbul/ de nas thog mar dam tshig drang zhing kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyad/ rang dang tshogs la 'dus pa thams cad la lha'i 'du shes dang*/ bza' ba dang btung ba thams cad la ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i 'du shes dang*/ longs spyad pa thams cad la lha mchod pa'i 'du shes dang*/ thams cad kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes par bya ba la yang dang yang du gsal gdab bo// tshim pa dang lhag ma rnams bsags la 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas kha phru gdab cing oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/

a kā ro'i mthar oṃ sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ de nas byin dbab pa'i phyir rdo rje'i glu blangs te/ kol+la i re ṭaṭhi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ṇe kṛ pi ta ho bādz+dzā i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dzā i/ gā ḍheṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dzā i/ ha li kā liñdza ra pā ṇi a i/ dun+du ra bādz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu rī sih+lā/ kāp+pu ra lā i a i/ mā la in+dha na sā liñdza/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ phreṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dhe na mu ṇi a i/ ni rāṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pā ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun du ru bā ṭā i/ ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta hin+na bādz+dzi a i/ zhes brjod nas phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas kyang byin dbab par bya'o// de nas yi ge brgya pa brjod nas cho ga lhag chad kha bskangs la/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rje can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab bo// de nas mdun du rten med na mdun du bskyed pa dang*/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol lo// rten yod na/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol mi dgos/ rang gi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrung*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas nas/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// rgya chen rab zab bsod nams ye shes tshogs// gzhan du grangs med bskal par 'grub dka' ba// gang gis bde blag nyid du rdzogs byed pa'i// thabs tshul 'di ni rgyud kyi snying po yin// tshul 'di dad ldan la'u shu zhes bya bas// gsol ba btab nas sngags 'chang 'phags pas sbyar// dge ba de yis ma lus 'gro ba kun// bsod nams ye shes dpal gyis rol bar shog
/tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga chos rje sa skya pa'i phyag len bzhin du/ chu mo phag gi lo dbyar zla 'bring po la rgyal po chen po'i pho brang chen por sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
